title: fix(service-analytics): the SQL echo prints SQL Server's own row window, and JSON refusals name the mssql dialect
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92fRd3AKk79RdDzBKEzccPL)_
Fixes #31626

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 仪表盘「查看 SQL」（`/analytics/sql`）对 SQL Server 联邦对象打印的分页改成 SQL Server 自己的写法（`TOP (n)` / `OFFSET … ROWS FETCH NEXT … ROWS ONLY`），这套规则从 driver-sql 挪进 `@objectstack/core`，两边共用一份；JSON 成员/空列表的拒绝提示改为点名 `mssql`，不再说方言「未知」。
- **为什么改：** 实测：SQL Server 联邦对象的仪表盘本来就走 driver 聚合，行是对的；但打印出来的 SQL 是 `LIMIT 10 OFFSET 5`，SQL Server 根本跑不了，误导人和 AI。
- **风险与回滚：** 低。driver-sql 的实际语句逐字节不变（11 组分页逐字节钉住）；SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL 打印的 SQL 不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/core/src/utils/mssql-window-sql.ts`（规则本身）、`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-crud.ts`（find 的分页段）、`packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts`（`windowClauseSql` / `windowTopSql`）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/objectql-echo-offset-only-window.test.ts -t 31626`，应见 15 个通过、live 两条在无 `OS_TEST_MSSQL_URL` 时具名跳过。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/core`: `mssqlWindow` / `mssqlWindowSql` / `MSSQL_NEUTRAL_ORDER_SQL`** (new `utils/mssql-window-sql.ts`). SQL Server's window rules, held once: an `OFFSET` needs an `ORDER BY` (`(SELECT NULL)` when the read has none); `limit: 0` is `TOP (0)` and drops the offset; an offset of `0` is no offset; a lone limit is `TOP (n)`. Each window is the one knex 3.3.0's SQL Server compiler builds after driver-sql's two rules.
- **`@objectstack/driver-sql`: the find path decides its SQL Server window with `mssqlWindow`** instead of its inline copy (`sql-driver-crud.ts`). knex still renders it; the statements are byte-identical (pinned below). The other dialects' branch is untouched.
- **`@objectstack/service-analytics`: `windowClauseSql` takes an `ordered` flag and renders SQL Server through `mssqlWindowSql`;** a new `windowTopSql` puts the `TOP (n)` after `SELECT`. Both the ObjectQL echo (`generateSql`, `/analytics/sql`) and the native statement use them. The `mssql` cell of `OFFSET_ONLY_LIMIT_SQL` is gone (SQL Server has no `LIMIT`).
- **Refusal text:** the four refusals for a JSON membership test (`$contains` / `$notContains` on a JSON-stored field) and a multi-value `$empty` (the `where` door and the read scope, `contains-membership-sql.ts`, `empty-operator-sql.ts`, `read-scope-sql.ts`) name the dialect through a new `noJsonFunctionReason` (`text-match-sql.ts`): `this analytics host emits no such function for the datasource's dialect, "mssql"`. The text for `'unknown'` is byte-identical. Envelopes (`INVALID_FILTER` / 400, `READ_SCOPE_COMPILE_FAILED` / 500) unchanged.

### Item 2 (the boolean aggregand) closes unreachable — not built, not deferred

Per the seat's ruling (card comment 6730940207): the `bit` aggregand cast lives only on the native-SQL face, and the native face is never selected for a SQL Server object in the shape every in-repo producer writes. `plugin.ts:1506` reports an object with an `external` binding as external, and `NativeSQLStrategy.canHandle` declines it (ADR-0062 D6), so the engine aggregate runs and driver-sql's own `mssqlAggregandOperandSql` applies. The echo prints a bare `SUM(col)` on every dialect, so it has no aggregand arm to fix. The one shape that reaches the native face, an object routed to a SQL Server datasource with no `external` block, is a shape no producer writes; its boot already raises the schema-sync ERROR, and it is out of scope (no card).

### Why this route (seat ruling B, from the step-0 report 6730929594)

- **Real need, measured:** on `main` `0105a687`, through the plugin's own composition over a real `SqlDriver` on knex's `mssql` client, a producer-shaped federated object ran `aggregate` only, while `generateSql` printed `… GROUP BY region LIMIT 10 OFFSET 5` (and `LIMIT 9223372036854775807 OFFSET 5` for an offset alone). The echo is the only public reach, and the window clause is the one construct the echo and the native face share.
- **Long-term:** the window rules live once, in core, beside the text-match table #31394 moved there; no third copy.
- **AI-safety:** an echo that prints SQL the database cannot parse is the misleading output a model copies into hand-written SQL; it now prints what runs.
- **Startup scope:** item 2 would have widened core's `AggregandSqlDialect` for a shape with no producer; not built.

### Forced test changes

None. Every existing assertion is unchanged; the new pins are top-level `describe`s in the existing harness files (`sql-driver-mssql-dialect.test.ts`, `objectql-echo-offset-only-window.test.ts`, `contains-membership.test.ts`, `where-empty-operator.test.ts`, `read-scope-empty-operator.test.ts`) plus `mssql-window-sql.test.ts` for the new core module.

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins — red on base 0105a687, green on head</summary>

Base leg: the seven changed source files restored to `0105a687` (`git restore --source`), driver-sql rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` confirmed `mssqlWindow` absent from its dist, then the `-t 31626` pins run; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git status --porcelain` empty, rebuilt, preflight confirmed the marker present.

- Base: **20 failed**, 3 passed: the 11 echo-window rows but one (`no window`), the measured row, both live rows, 4 membership refusals, 2 `$empty` where refusals, the `$empty` read-scope refusal. The 3 that pass on both legs are the controls (`no window`, sqlite/postgres/mysql bytes, scalar `$empty` rows).
- driver-sql's 11 find-statement pins: **11/11 green on base AND head** — the byte-identity of the move.
- Head: all green (below).

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and live cell (head)</summary>

- `pnpm test`: core exit 0, driver-sql exit 0, service-analytics exit 0 (after a full closure build of service-analytics and its dependencies).
- `pnpm typecheck`: core exit 0, driver-sql exit 0, service-analytics exit 0 (re-run on 367f87a7 after replacing `Array.at` in two new pins).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on each of the three package dirs: exit 0.
- **Live SQL Server 2022** (container-only, CI provisions none so the cell is a named skip there): `OS_TEST_MSSQL_URL` set, `objectql-echo-offset-only-window.test.ts` 18 passed / 3 skipped (the postgres cell). The echoed statements ran on the server: ordered `offset 1` / `limit 2 offset 1` / `limit 2` answered their groups; unordered `limit 2 offset 1` ran via `ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)`; `limit 0` with and without an offset answered no rows. On base both live rows were red.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The echo's JSON membership / `$empty` compilers refuse on SQL Server, while driver-sql's own filter path refuses the same operators there too (`[#31327] JSON-array fields: refused` in `sql-driver-mssql-dialect.test.ts`), so the two faces agree; only the wording changed.
- The native-SQL face's `bit` aggregand on SQL Server stays as-stored (item 2 above).

## Verification

Gates on head `367f87a7` (run after the last commit): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived **76** families from the 16-path change set; all 76 ran locally, **76 exit 0**, reconciled with `--ran`: `76 derived, 76 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no dist for 77 packages) and was re-run after `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0); that re-run's 0 is the recorded code. The CI-only families (artifact roster, wide-population, path-scheduled jobs) are read from this PR's check-runs.

Driver conformance: base 66 covered / 6 DEBT; head 66 covered / 6 DEBT (unchanged).
